bear_assumptions: Normalized common EPS near USD 0.75 at 20x if commodity and protected economics weaken, magnet ramps slip, capital needs stay high and dilution absorbs enterprise progress.
base_assumptions: Normalized common EPS near USD 1.75 at 20x if supported Materials economics persist, Independence qualifies, 10X stays on plan and current liquidity funds construction without severe dilution.
bull_assumptions: Normalized common EPS near USD 3.00 at 24x if separated products and magnets scale on schedule, contracts convert to cash, customers diversify and dilution remains bounded.
rating_change_conditions: Require the mark at or below the deterministic buy-below price plus adequate expected and base upside, accepted relationship evidence and intact funding support before allocation; downgrade further on contract impairment, appropriations risk, delayed magnet qualification, construction overruns, liquidity erosion or severe dilution.
